caption: Rank-1 almost_full plots on local test_v25. Hurdle modes follow the picker (ev / am25 / am50 / am75 / am80 / am85 / am90 / amstar). amstar τ* was fit on train to max R² / min MSE and frozen.

baseline.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: MSE_Baseline
baseline.note: Baseline Model:: This is the standard baseline model trained using vanilla Mean Squared Error (MSE) with no target transformations or sample weighting applied.

pkg02.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Logit_MAE
pkg02.note: Target Transformation (Logit):: The target variable was modeled in Logit (log-odds) space to enforce predictions between `[0, 1]` and trained using Mean Absolute Error (MAE). An inverse-logit (`expit`) transformation has been applied to all model predictions in this document to return them to the original probability space for direct comparison against the true target.

pkg03.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Weighted_Xentropy
pkg03.note: Loss Function Quirk (Sample-Weighted Cross-Entropy):: This package trained the models using Cross-Entropy loss while applying continuous sample weights based on the true target. A target of `0.0` was assigned a weight of `100.0`, while a target of `1.0` was assigned a weight of `2.5` (a 40:1 ratio), forcing the models to prioritize minimizing False Positives (predicting a bad user when they are actually good).

pkg05.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0244
pkg05.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.0244` quantile ($\tau = 0.0244$). The models are explicitly trained to predict the 2.44th percentile of the conditional distribution rather than the mean, enforcing extreme conservatism against False Positives.

pkg06.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0200
pkg06.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.200` quantile ($\tau = 0.200$). The models are explicitly trained to predict the 20th percentile of the conditional distribution, providing a softer asymmetric buffer than the 0.0244 model.

pkg07.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Weighted_MSE
pkg07.note: Loss Function Quirk (Continuous Sample-Weighted MSE):: This package uses standard Mean Squared Error but applies a continuous target-based sample weight, penalizing False Positives substantially more than False Negatives.

pkg08.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0300
pkg08.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.300` quantile ($\tau = 0.300$).

pkg09.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0400
pkg09.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.400` quantile ($\tau = 0.400`).

pkg10.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0250
pkg10.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.250` quantile ($\tau = 0.250`).

pkg11.title: Error & Distribution Analysis: Pinball_0350
pkg11.note: Loss Function Quirk (Quantile Regression):: This package uses Pinball Loss configured for the `0.350` quantile ($\tau = 0.350`).
